label: Uneasy calm
summary: Hopes for reopening the Strait of Hormuz dimmed as Iran said two tankers caught fire after hitting mines, even as Araghchi insisted talks with mediators continue. Netanyahu called Israel's election 'stolen' while officials said the results stand. In Ukraine, air-raid alert apps were hit by cyberattacks as a local truce ended. The US heads into Tuesday's midterms amid reports the White House is planning to govern without Congress. DR Congo's Ebola toll passed 5,000, and El Niño deepened drought in Malawi while floods struck Ecuador. Brighter notes: volunteers built 108 stupas in Bhutan, Atlantic islands switched off lights to save seabird fledglings, and researchers reported a sound-wave attack on deadly brain cancer. The weighted formula gave 43; no editorial adjustment.
